wins.text: Net income of $4.1B, EPS of $1.96, ROTCE of 9.1% on $21.6B revenues; positive operating leverage delivered for the firm and all 5 business lines
Markets revenue up 12% YoY; equities up 23% driven by derivatives and prime services (prime balances up ~16%); fixed income up 8%
Wealth revenue up 24% with record quarterly revenue; net new investment assets of $16.5B in the quarter and $56B+ over last 12 months (~11% organic growth)
M&A revenue nearly doubled (up 84% YoY); overall banking revenues up 12%; expenses declined 5% YoY driving positive operating leverage
Returned $2.8B in capital including $1.75B in buybacks — highest quarterly buyback since 2022 — as part of $20B repurchase program; tangible book value per share crossed $90; CET1 at 13.4%

risks.text: Firm-wide net ACL build reflecting deterioration in macroeconomic outlook; CECL framework now incorporates 8-quarter weighted average unemployment of 5.1% with downside scenario averaging 6.7%, signaling meaningful macro stress assumptions
Cost of credit was $2.7B, primarily net credit losses in cards; card reserve-to-funded-loan ratio increased to 8.2% from 7.9%; NCL rates increased sequentially in both card portfolios

Prolonged tariff and trade war uncertainty causing clients to pause CapEx plans, stockpile inventories, and derisk — management acknowledged 'wait-and-see mode' and 'more negative macro outlook than anyone had anticipated'

Retail Services revenues declined 11% YoY driven by higher partner payment accruals; ECM down 26% amid pullback in follow-ons and convertibles; All Other revenues declined 39% including impact of Mexican peso depreciation
Banamex IPO timing uncertain — regulatory approvals and market conditions could push IPO from 2025 into 2026; ongoing transformation investments still required with expenses expected to tick up in Q2

guidance_items.detail: Full year 2025 revenues of approximately $83.1B–$84.1B unchanged; NII ex-markets expected up ~2%–3%
ROTCE target of 10%–11% for 2026 reaffirmed; no change to full-year EPS framework
Full year expenses expected slightly below $53.4B (adjusted for card processing fee reclassification); 2026 expense target recalibrated to ~$52.6B
Card NCL guidance unchanged; seasonal pickup in H1 expected to trend down in H2; NII ex-markets guidance now assumes 4 Fed cuts (vs. prior 2–3) but back-loaded timing limits impact

analyst_concerns_not_in_prepared: Potential restrictions or limitations on dividending capital from bank subsidiary to holding company for buyback execution
Risk of mandates shifting from U.S. broker-dealers to local/regional players outside the U.S. amid geopolitical tensions
Banamex IPO timing risk and shareholder implications of holding the business longer if market conditions deteriorate
